Method of Attack: Universal Cross-site Scripting (UXSS) vulnerability allowing bypass of browser's same origin policy to execute code in iframes beyond Evernote's domain, enabling theft of cookies, credentials, private information, and performing actions as the user
Impacted Systems: Evernote Web Clipper Chrome extension users
Attack Vector: Redirecting users to hacker-controlled websites that load hidden iframes with targeted third-party websites, triggering malicious payload injection
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious payload injected into iframes stealing cookies, credentials, private information; vulnerable Evernote Web Clipper Chrome extension versions below 7.11.1
